module.purpose: Provides Meta-internal (FB) bundler-specific implementation of React Flight client config, mapping client references to JSResource modules and supplying server-side resolution stubs for server actions.
module.summary: This module is the Facebook-internal binding for React Flight's client configuration. It exports functions to prepare, resolve, preload, and require client references, plus a debug-info collector. On the server (no DOM) it uses synchronous require with Haste module names; on the client it leverages JSResource and the Bootloader to asynchronously load chunks. It also resolves server references (action replies) by constructing a client reference with a null bootloader payload. Debug info is cached per module filename and built from performance timing when available.
module.businessContext: Part of React Flight (Server Components) RPC infrastructure at Meta. Enables client component loading and server action decoding. Failures break rendering of client components or server actions.
functions: prepareDestinationForModule (~L44-50): Delegates to impl with bootloader payload
resolveClientReference (~L52-57): Returns metadata as client reference unchanged
resolveServerReference (~L63-72): Creates client reference from id for server action
preloadModule (~L76-112): Loads module via JSResource on client, null on server

getModuleDebugInfo (~L156-239): Builds React debug/io info for module chunk

network: Requests module chunk via JSResource.load() on client

Mutates fakeStack.stack string to synthetic frames

moduleLayout: import type {Thenable, FulfilledThenable, RejectedThenable, ReactDebugInfo, ReactIOInfo, ReactAsyncInfo} from 'shared/ReactTypes'
export opaque type ClientReferenceMetadata = { $$typeof: symbol, $$id: string, $$hblp: mixed }
export opaque type ClientReference<T> = { $$typeof: symbol, $$id: string, $$hblp: mixed }
const asyncModuleCache: Map<string, Thenable<any>> = new Map()
const moduleIOInfoCache: Map<string, ReactIOInfo> = __DEV__ ? new Map() : (null as any)
module.moduleLevelCode: Import statements and const asyncModuleCache / moduleIOInfoCache initialization; no top-level execution besides cache creation.

detail.name: prepareDestinationForModule

nonce is either a string or null
postconditions: Internal prepareDestinationForModuleImpl has been invoked with the resolved arguments
edgeCases: metadata.$$hblp may be of any type accepted by the internal impl
detail.summary: Delegates to the internal implementation to prepare the module loading destination using the provided module loading config, optional nonce, and client reference metadata handle.

units.name: resolveClientReference

detail.name: resolveClientReference
detail.signature: export function resolveClientReference<T>(bundlerConfig: ServerConsumerModuleMap, metadata: ClientReferenceMetadata): ClientReference<T>
postconditions: Returns the exact metadata argument passed in
edgeCases: Any value supplied as metadata (including null or undefined) is returned unchanged
detail.summary: Acts as a pass-through resolver that returns the provided client reference metadata unchanged for the FB bundler configuration.

units.name: resolveServerReference

detail.name: resolveServerReference
detail.signature: export function resolveServerReference<T>(config: ServerManifest, id: ServerReferenceId): ClientReference<T>
preconditions: `config` of type ServerManifest is supplied (though unused in body)
postconditions: Returns an object with `$$typeof` equal to Symbol.for('react.client.reference'), `$$id` equal to the provided `id`, and `$$hblp` equal to null
Returned value is typed as ClientReference<T> (cast as any)
edgeCases: The `config` parameter is ignored and does not affect the output
Any `id` value is assigned directly without validation
detail.summary: Constructs a client reference object for a given server reference id, tagging it with the React client reference symbol and attaching the id.

specLiterals.role: Identifies the returned object as a React client reference

units.name: preloadModule

detail.name: preloadModule
detail.signature: export function preloadModule<T>(metadata: ClientReference<T>): null | Thenable<any>
preconditions: metadata is a ClientReference with $$id property
postconditions: Returns null if on server or module already requireable
Returns a Thenable that is cached in asyncModuleCache under metadata.$$id
The returned thenable has status, value/reason attached upon settlement
invariants: asyncModuleCache holds the module promise keyed by metadata.$$id during load
edgeCases: Server env (canUseDOM false): returns null synchronously
metadata.$$hblp present: registers payload with window.Bootloader before load
detail.summary: Given a client reference metadata, returns null when on server or module already available, otherwise initiates load and returns a thenable that tracks its fulfillment or rejection status.

specLiterals.role: metadata property used as cache key
module specifier required to get jsr

specTests.then: returns null and does not attempt to require JSResource
returns a Thenable, caches it by metadata.$$id, and resolves with status 'fulfilled' or 'rejected'

units.name: requireModule

detail.name: requireModule
preconditions: metadata is a ClientReference with a $$id property
on server (no DOM), require is available
on client, JSResource module is resolvable
postconditions: returns the module exports (or specific export) synchronously
on client, if module not requireable and not in async cache as fulfilled, throws
edgeCases: If canUseDOM is false and $$id contains '#', splits into moduleName and exportName; if exportName is '' or 'default', returns mod.default if __esModule else mod; else returns mod[exportName].
If canUseDOM is false and no '#', returns require(id) directly.
If canUseDOM is true and JSResource getModuleIfRequireable returns non-null, returns those exports.
If canUseDOM is true and asyncModuleCache has fulfilled promise for id, returns promise.value; else throws promise.reason.

raises: throws promise.reason if client and module not available (possibly undefined)

detail.summary: Resolves and returns the module or export referenced by a ClientReference metadata, synchronously on server via require() with Haste names, or via JSResource/async cache on client.

specLiterals.role: delimiter separating module name and export name in metadata.$$id
export name indicating default export when empty
promise status indicating cached module available
